content_sections.heading: CSIR-CSIO Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: CSIR-CSIO Chandigarh has notified 6 vacancies across 3 posts. The reservation break-up for each post is given below.

rows.no_of_posts: 04 (03-UR, 01-OBC); 01 post out of these is reserved for Ex-Servicemen (ESM)

rows.essential_qualification_eligibility: Ex-Servicemen JCO (Subedar or higher rank) OR equivalent rank in other Paramilitary forces with a minimum of 10 years' experience in security. The experience requirement is 5 years for Short Service Commissioned Officers and incumbents holding the position of Assistant Commandant in CRPF/BSF/ITBP etc. carrying the pre-revised pay scale of Rs. 8000-13500. For Inspectors from Paramilitary Forces, the required experience is 10 years.
Graduate with two years' relevant experience as Receptionist in a Government/Autonomous Body/Public Sector Undertaking.
Valid driving licence for LMV & HMV; working knowledge of motor mechanism (able to remove minor vehicle defects); at least 3 years' experience driving a motor car; and a pass in 10th standard.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CSIO Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum age for all posts is 18 years. Standard age relaxation applies for OBC (NCL) candidates (3 years, where the post is reserved for that category), Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (10 years, 13 years for OBC-PwBD, subject to a maximum age of 56 years), Ex-Servicemen (3 years, or deduction of actual military service), and Widows/Divorced/Judicially Separated Women (up to 35 years, 38 years for OBC), as per Government of India rules. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CSIO 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: In addition to basic pay, selected candidates get Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance and other benefits admissible to central government employees, along with Medical reimbursement, Leave Travel Concession and Children Education Allowance as per CSIR rules. Employees are covered under the New Pension Scheme.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CSIO Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The fee must be paid online only through State Bank Collect, and the transaction number must be entered correctly in the application form. Candidates should download and retain the e-receipt for future reference.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CSIO Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Physical and Personality Assessment Test (qualifying in nature) Written Test - Paper I: Mental Ability and Personality Assessment Test (100 questions, 100 marks, no negative marking); Paper II: Comprehension, Report Writing, Security Regulations & Firefighting, and General Awareness (25 marks each, subjective) Final merit is based on Paper II performance, subject to qualifying the threshold in Paper I (30%) and Paper II (minimum 35%, as fixed by the Selection Committee) Selection is through a Personality Assessment Test. Skill Test (qualifying) Written Test - 100 objective-type questions across General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness and English Language (25 questions each, 3 marks per correct answer, 1 negative mark per wrong answer); total 300 marks; duration 90 minutes Final merit list is based on written test performance Both written tests (Security Officer, Driver) are OMR/Computer-based objective examinations set bilingually in English and Hindi (except the English Language paper for Driver), and can be attempted in either English or Hindi medium.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CSIO Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents
content_sections.text: Recent passport-size photograph and signature (scanned, as per prescribed format) Proof of educational qualification(s) from 10th standard onwards Proof of relevant work experience, where applicable Category certificate (OBC/SC/ST), issued in the prescribed Government of India format, if applicable PwBD certificate (Form V/VI/VII) indicating 40% or more benchmark disability, if claiming disability relaxation/reservation Ex-Servicemen discharge certificate/Performa-IV, if applicable CGPA/SGPA/OGPA-to-percentage conversion formula certificate, if the qualifying degree is graded (not in percentage) Equivalence order/notification, if claiming an equivalent qualification Certified translation (attested by a Gazetted Officer/Notary) for any certificate not in English or Hindi Applications without the required photograph, signature, educational qualification proof, experience proof, or supporting documents are liable to be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for CSIR-CSIO Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official CSIR-CSIO website: www.csio.res.in Read the instructions for the online application carefully before starting Register with a valid, active email ID (create one first if you don't already have one) Fill in the online application form with personal, educational and experience details accurately Upload the required documents, photograph and signature as specified Pay the applicable application fee online through State Bank Collect (if not exempted) Submit the application and note down the generated Application Form Number for future reference Download and save the confirmation page/e-receipt; printouts need not be sent by post

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR-CSIO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 14 September 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-CSIO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies in total: 1 Security Officer, 1 Receptionist, and 4 Driver posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for CSIR-CSIO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹590 (₹500 + GST) for General/OBC/EWS candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and Women candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Driver post at CSIR-CSIO?
faq.answer: A pass in 10th standard, a valid LMV & HMV driving licence, knowledge of motor mechanism, and at least 3 years of car-driving experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR-CSIO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for Security Officer, 28 years for Receptionist, and 27 years for Driver, as on the last date of application, with standard government relaxations applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Security Officer post at CSIR-CSIO?
faq.answer: Security Officer carries Pay Matrix Level-7 (₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400), with approximate total monthly emoluments of ₹93,758 at Chandigarh.
